interpretation_and_limits: Names and lexical scopes do not establish subsystem boundaries, class hierarchy or dynamic receivers; qualified field occurrences are not distinct names or functions.

RTTI binding/header/executable-prefix matches remain structural under declared layout predicates. Bit63 pointer normalization is a candidate interpretation. The 128-slot cap, non-executable stop, selected sections and offset-to-top range do not establish full table extents or absence of other classes.
The old named-table export includes eight imported RTTI pseudo-addresses with raw word 0x10 and one data value; its 2,191 slot-like records are not all callable methods.

The normal dyld stream was parsed through DONE with explicit uint64 wrapping and bounds checks. Actual duplicate binding locations are zero; malformed, signed-overflow and unsigned-wrap controls are meaningful.

The 25,071 baseline counts nonempty exported references including computed jumps and non-function destinations; 21,685 is the separate known-function-target site count. Added 24 records remain conditional static overlay inventory.

The 24-site cohort is bounded and deliberately selected, not representative whole-program recovery. All other classes and the 53,635 lexical store candidates need receiver/lifetime/native-PC evidence before attachment.
